earlyExit.intro: The review was not completed and the report is incomplete due to the following issues:

findings.message: A build dependency this add-on declares has known security vulnerabilities: lint-pebble (0.4.0) is affected by published advisories of critical severity (GHSA-fixture-pebble). It is not shipped, but reviewers build the add-on from source, so it runs on the reviewer's machine during the build. Update lint-pebble to 0.4.1 or later.

A package this add-on does not declare, but that one of its dependencies pulls in, has known security vulnerabilities: wick-trim (1.0.1) is affected by published advisories of high severity (CVE-2026-11111). It ends up in the code you ship. Update the declared dependency that pulls it in, which usually resolves this because a newer release often already depends on a fixed version (1.0.3 or later for wick-trim). If no update resolves it, consider moving to a different or simpler build chain.
